swiss.label: Swiss
swiss.description: Players with similar records play each other; rematches are avoided.

round_robin.label: Round robin
round_robin.description: Every player plays every other player exactly once.

games.label: By games (3 · 2 · 1 · 0)
games.description: A win without dropping a game is worth 3 points, a win that dropped a game 2, a loss that won a game 1, any other loss 0. A 2:0 therefore ranks above a 2:1.

match.label: Classic (3 · 0)
match.description: A win is 3 points, a loss 0, whatever the games. (A draw is 1, only in older tournaments.)

none.label: No points
none.description: A player who sits out gets no points and no match played.

win.label: Like a 2:0 win
win.description: A player who sits out gets 3 points, as after a 2:0 win.
